> **OWNER REVIEW REQUIRED.** Submit agent changes from the engineering GitHub App identity, never as @jmsgnnr. No merges or deployments without explicit owner approval.

## Why this change?
State product impact and motivation in plain English. No filler.

## What changed?
Describe changed paths and important limitations.

## How was it verified?
Provide exact test commands, outputs and visual/browser evidence. Name missing tests.

## Risks, integrations and release impact
List dependencies, security, permissions, data, migrations, known issues, rollbacks and deployment needs.

## Owner decision requested
What specifically should @jmsgnnr review? State whether PR is DRAFT or ready.
